top.author: @Dating_Diary2
top.text: This is honestly painful to read. What feels like “spark” shouldn’t come from betrayal or chaos… that’s just emotional damage dressed as excitement. A peaceful, faithful love isn’t boring, it’s just new to someone used to turbulence.
top.translationZh: 说实话看着都心疼。所谓的"激情"不应该来自背叛或混乱...那只是伪装成刺激的情感创伤。平静忠诚的爱情不是无聊，只是对习惯了狂风暴雨的人来说比较陌生罢了。
